recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic blue-tinted urban scene featuring a group of figures in oversized streetwear, arranged in a symmetrical back-to-back formation with a central typographic lockup using contrasting warm tones.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic blue environment vs. warm-toned central text
Symmetrical group posing around a vertical axis
High-contrast shadows against a soft, diffused blue highlight
Oversized silhouettes creating a heavy, grounded visual weight
coreInvariants: Deep cobalt and cyan duotone color grade
Centralized vertical alignment for all text elements
Figures wearing heavy, textured parkas or utility jackets
Urban alleyway or street background with soft focus

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures occupy the full height of the frame, arranged in pairs facing outward from the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central graphic logo-mark positioned at the chest level of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central logo, move downward through the secondary text, then outward to the silhouetted figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with the subjects' forms.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue used for shadows and midtones across the entire image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and light blue for highlights on clothing and skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted peach and vibrant red for the central typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues with crushed blacks; typography uses high-value contrast to pop against the cool background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid greens and yellows in the background
Limit warm tones strictly to the central text elements

letterConstructionRules: Primary logo uses a vertically elongated, arched diamond shape
Secondary text uses a clean, geometric sans-serif with phonetic diacritics
Tertiary text is a bold, condensed sans-serif with tight tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Outer letters of the main logo are scaled down to fit a circular or diamond-shaped container
Central letters are elongated to create a vertical peak
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex, warped custom logo paired with a clean, functional sans-serif for legibility.

preserve: Vertical elongation of the main logo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed feel of the bottom text.
Basis for the warped central logo skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of four men in 90s urban streetwear (parkas, beanies) standing back-to-back in a city alleyway. Apply a heavy cobalt blue duotone filter so the entire image is shades of blue and cyan with deep black shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center a vertically-stretched diamond-shaped logo in peach with a black outline. Below it, add a line of small white sans-serif text in parentheses. At the bottom center, add a bold, condensed red sans-serif title.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic blue except for the text?
Is the central logo warped into a diamond/oval shape?
Are the figures wearing oversized 90s-style jackets?
Is the text perfectly centered horizontally?

adjustableVariables: Specific warp shape of the central logo
Number of figures in the group
Accent color of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue tint covers the skin tones completely.
Check that the red text is legible against the dark blue background.
Verify the diamond warp of the logo doesn't make it unreadable.
Confirm the subjects look like a unified group.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Group + Duotone Blue Filter + Vertically Warped Central Logo + Bold Condensed Bottom Title
